1. A filter covering for a sterile container lid, for completely covering at least one gas exchange portion, which is provided on a lid component of the sterile container lid, on an outside of the sterile container lid, the filter covering defining a main plane and comprising at least two clip portions arranged opposite to each other on the filter covering, which are adapted to engage in a form-fitting manner in at least two clip receiving portions provided on the lid component, and by which the filter covering is mountable to and dismountable from the lid component without tools, the filter covering being a plate having a height, a length and a width, wherein the height is less than the length and less than the width, the at least two clip portions being formed as portions bent away from the main plane in a bracket- or a C-shaped manner.
2. The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the filter covering is made of a plastic material in one piece.
3. The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the at least two clip portions are arranged on opposite sides and/or ends of the filter covering.
4. The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the at least two clip portions are positioned to engage in the at least two clip receiving portions on opposite sides and/or ends of the lid component.
5. The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the filter covering is a rectangular plate.
6. The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the at least two clip portions consist of exactly two clip portions.
7. The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the filter covering is rectangular with a first side, a second side opposite the first side, a third side, and a fourth side opposite the third side, the at least two clip portions being provided on the first side and the second side.
8. The filter covering according to claim 7, wherein the at least two clip portions are not provided on the third side and the fourth side.
9. The filter covering according to claim 7, wherein the first side and the second side are shorter than the third side and the fourth side, respectively, and
wherein the first side and the second side each comprise one of the at least two clip portions.
10. The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the at least two clip portions are configured to be clipped onto the at least two clip receiving portions.
11. The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein each of the at least two clip portions is a bracket-shaped side portion of the filter covering, and each bracket-shaped side portion comprises a laterally outwardly projecting grip portion, the laterally outwardly projecting grip portions being manually operable when the filter covering is mounted to and dismounted from the lid component of the sterile container lid.
12. The filter covering according to claim 11, wherein each laterally outwardly projecting grip portion extends parallel to the main plane.
13. The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the filter covering is made from amorphous thermoplastic and is transparent for visually inspecting a filter device arranged on a lid inner side of a gas exchange portion.
14. The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the filter covering is at least partially transparent.
15. The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the filter covering is an injection- molded part.
16. The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the filter covering is elastically bendable. 11 / 14 12 / 14 13 / 14 5 10 15 20 25 30
